user_query: I'm planning a road trip with my friends and we need a good playlist. Search for tracks related to travel and adventure on Soundcloud and suggest some songs. Also, provide me with the lyrics of one of the recommended songs using SongMeanings.

TaskList.description: Search for tracks related to travel and adventure on Soundcloud.
Suggest some songs based on the tracks retrieved from Soundcloud.
Fetch the lyrics of one of the recommended songs using SongMeanings.
